create_ernie_config: create an ErnieConfig instance with default ERNIE 3.0 base Chinese model settings
initialize_ernie_model: initialize an ErnieModel with a custom ErnieConfig specifying layer and attention parameters
access_model_config: access the configuration object from an instantiated ErnieModel via the config attribute
customize_ernie_parameters: customize ErnieConfig parameters like hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and vocab_size for a variant model
verify_ernie_config_type: verify that ErnieConfig model_type is set to ernie and inherits from PreTrainedConfig
